evals.prompt: Chris approved local audio for a 12-second 60fps product film. Supplied VO and music have controlled release/licence references. A 12-frame completion effect is needed; no model installation, account connection or external upload is authorized. Explain and prepare the source production/selection hand-off. The VO recording has not yet been inspected. Do not claim a generated or listened result.
evals.expected_output: Preserves supplied originals/hashes and exact approved text; requests actual source inspection/listening/phrase marks. Uses deterministic technical synthesis only for the effect, 9600 stereo48k sample frames from 12/60 seconds, through an installed absolute Skill root. Records spec/seed/rights, new-output behavior and selection status. Sends originals/edits/cue revision/fingerprint/transcript/provenance to finishing without claiming narration/music quality or cloud access.
evals.comparison: Same brief with and without Skill; hold model/host/assets/route/budget constant and retain source plans and independent reviewer findings.

evals.prompt: Chris is choosing a local or hybrid route for a multilingual narrated ad. Someone proposes Kokoro for every language and voice cloning, and Stable Audio Small on Windows because the repository is MIT. No model has been installed, language coverage/hardware/storage have not been checked and external uploads are not approved. Give a concrete preflight and alternative without installing or calling anything.
evals.expected_output: Separates code MIT from Stable Audio model Community terms; identifies CPU Windows documentation as a lead, not local execution proof. Kokoro Apache weights and limited covered language/voice set do not imply all-language or general user-voice cloning. Checks exact release/licence/hardware/storage/runtime/language/consent through Chris before project-local install; proposes supplied/new authorized recording and no silent cloud fallback. Inference/listening/host availability remain unverified.
evals.comparison: Matched with-Skill/without-Skill pair with identical constraints and dated source material; score decision accuracy, scope and evidence honesty.
